profile.name: Amina El-Sayed
profile.current_summary: Secondary-school educator transitioning into customer success after leading learner onboarding, stakeholder communication, and progress reviews.

bullets.text: Designed onboarding sessions and learning plans for new students and their families.
Led quarterly progress reviews with families, teachers, and school leadership to resolve concerns.
Created training materials and facilitated workshops for teachers adopting new classroom tools.
Tracked onboarding participation and adoption progress for new students using structured progress reports.
Responded to stakeholder questions and coordinated follow-up actions across families and school teams.
Maintained accurate learner records in the school information system and escalated data issues.

job_description:

- Run stakeholder progress reviews and resolve concerns
- Maintain customer activity in Salesforce CRM

Candidates should present only experience and qualifications they can verify.
